en: Tinted vintage view of a park path with benches and a gas-style lamppost in the foreground, where two figures in old-fashioned clothing are seated. Behind the trees rises a square stone bell tower with arched openings and a small cupola on top. Roofs of nearby buildings are visible, and in the background are steep, rocky mountains. The overall style resembles an early 20th‑century colorized postcard of a European town in a mountainous region.
